cases.prompt: Add three fixed alternate greetings with different starting state to this MVU card.
cases.expectedBehavior: Preserve the detected dialect, select per-greeting initialization, and retain a real-runtime acceptance gate.

cases.prompt: Make this MVU zod card work with both same-generation updates and the extra update-model pass without duplicating every worldbook entry into both model contexts.
cases.expectedBehavior: Verify runtime support, keep the variable list intentionally shared, route update rules and output format to the update model, route plot-only instructions to the plot model, preserve normal activation, and require both-mode acceptance.

cases.prompt: 为一张完全没有 MVU、变量或脚本的文字角色卡设计一套可以直接使用的自定义 CoT。
cases.expectedBehavior: Treat custom CoT as an independent author-written decision protocol, provide a concrete lightweight template with observable checks and fallback, and keep visible inner thoughts separate from system judgment.

cases.prompt: 我的预设已经有通用 CoT。给这张卡增加专属知情限制和只在战斗时触发的判断模块，不要复制整套预设。
cases.expectedBehavior: Keep the main CoT in the preset, declare card and conditional increments against stable phases and rule IDs, deduplicate and order them, protect the main structure, and provide a generated full fallback when stitching is unavailable.

cases.prompt: 为群像 MVU 系统卡设计 NPC 调度 CoT，并把额外更新模型和确定性脚本的工作拆开。
cases.expectedBehavior: Give the plot model ensemble scheduling and narrative CoT, limit the update model to semantic source events and legal updates, assign deterministic derived calculations to scripts, and prohibit competing writers.

cases.prompt: Identify this rolecard before editing it. It contains a packaged Zod Schema script, a packaged global MVU Zod script enabled by default, a packaged domestic MVU Zod script disabled by default, character-local regexes, and Git CDN imports inside those scripts. Tell me what the player really needs to install.
cases.expectedBehavior: Return an mvu_zod primary type from the schema, registration path, and packaged loader evidence; require the embedded schema plus both promised regional scripts with their declared enabled states; separate their Git CDN targets and Tavern Helper host requirement; and do not add a standalone Zod installation step.

cases.prompt: Split this packaged rolecard JSON into reusable components without changing the original file.
cases.expectedBehavior: Snapshot the input, decompose in a sandbox, declare dependencies, and require roundtrip comparison.

cases.prompt: Assemble the maintained sources, validate them, and produce versioned JSON and PNG release artifacts.
cases.expectedBehavior: Discover the project adapter, keep source and artifacts separate, and stop at explicit release gates.

cases.prompt: Package this MVU Zod card after confirming its required regexes, packaged Zod Schema, packaged domestic/global MVU Zod scripts, declared enabled states, and their Git CDN imports are complete.
cases.expectedBehavior: Reconcile detected and declared card capabilities, block a missing schema or promised regional script and any enabled-state mismatch, and report embedded assets, Tavern Helper setup, remote imports, and development-only exclusions separately.

cases.prompt: Package card version 2.4.0 with its attached and standalone companion worldbook, making sure an older 2.3.0 worldbook cannot be selected.
cases.expectedBehavior: Resolve both artifacts from the active manifest by stable ID, require a machine-checkable version surface, compare attached and standalone worldbooks with maintained source, and reject the stale version.

cases.prompt: What is the exact event name and callback signature for this Tavern Helper MVU hook?
cases.expectedBehavior: Verify an identified source/version and distinguish confirmed facts from inference.

cases.prompt: The status bar works offline but is blank after importing the card into SillyTavern. Diagnose it.
cases.expectedBehavior: Reproduce in a real runtime and trace DOM, console, iframe, permissions, data, and render evidence.

cases.prompt: Review and improve this rolecard control center for mobile, accessibility, and safe state handling.
cases.expectedBehavior: Review the embedded UI contract without introducing a React stack by default.

cases.prompt: Clean up and optimize this ugly but stable module.
cases.expectedBehavior: Audit and gate first; do not edit without evidence and implementation authorization.

cases.prompt: Build an accessible settings dashboard with React, shadcn/ui, Radix, and Tailwind.
cases.expectedBehavior: Use the requested stack, detect the project setup, and guard all generated writes.

cases.prompt: The rolecard workshop publish request now returns 502. Diagnose the chain before changing production.
cases.expectedBehavior: Trace the configurable public/gateway/storage chain read-only and require authorization before deploy or secret changes.

cases.prompt: Only update this character-local status-bar regex. Give me an importable test JSON and do not rebuild or package the rolecard.
cases.expectedBehavior: Freeze component mode, preserve the stable ID and untouched fields, emit only an importable regex artifact plus validation evidence, and produce no card JSON or PNG.

cases.prompt: Update these two Tavern Helper scripts and then package the complete card, but keep every unrelated component unchanged.
cases.expectedBehavior: Freeze full-card mode, build validated script artifacts and an assembly handoff with an untouched-surface hash, then route composition and packaging to sillytavern-card-pipeline.

cases.prompt: Prove whether this card regex runs for AI display at depth 0, is skipped for prompts, and stops after depth 4 using repeatable fixtures.
cases.expectedBehavior: Validate the regex dialect and flags, use the supplied numeric placement without guessing, run display/prompt/depth fixtures, and emit an ordered stage trace.

cases.prompt: The offline replacement passes but the imported regex does nothing in SillyTavern. Work out what the fixture does and what still needs live evidence.
cases.expectedBehavior: Keep the deterministic fixture result, list unsupported host stages, treat the installed runtime as authoritative, and hand exact runtime reproduction to sillytavern-runtime-debug.

cases.prompt: Before I import this card, scan its HTML, helper scripts, regex replacements, and remote loaders for security risks without running anything.
cases.expectedBehavior: Perform a read-only redacted scan, report rule IDs and locations without executing content or exposing credential values, and separate suspicious patterns from confirmed reachability.

cases.prompt: Compare this candidate's rolecard security report with the approved baseline and block any newly introduced rule count.
cases.expectedBehavior: Compare counts by stable rule ID, report positive deltas as regressions, and avoid treating a baseline as a suppression list.

cases.prompt: Migrate my quest table from status to state, add progress=0, preserve custom fields, and prove the migration is idempotent.
cases.expectedBehavior: Validate the multi-floor model, run a deterministic rename plus add-field fixture, preserve unknown data, compare expected output, and prove the second run is unchanged.

cases.prompt: Check that every status-bar and control-center binding names an existing table field and refreshes after message edits and swipes.
cases.expectedBehavior: Validate stable binding IDs, table and field references, access owner and refresh events, keep UI implementation separate, and retain real multi-floor lifecycle acceptance.

cases.prompt: Create a minimal SillyTavern UI extension with a manifest, activation hook, namespaced settings, and a capability contract, but do not install it.
cases.expectedBehavior: Freeze the UI-extension boundary, plan before writing, generate only the minimal scaffold, validate manifest paths and hook exports, and perform no host installation or reload.

cases.prompt: Check this extension against the versions and symbols captured from my target SillyTavern instance and tell me which optional features must fall back.
cases.expectedBehavior: Validate the inert capability snapshot, block missing required symbols or minimum versions, activate declared optional fallbacks, and keep signatures and live behavior unclaimed.

cases.prompt: Compare this assembled rolecard with the approved build and show exactly which size, prompt, worldbook, regex, script, or media budgets regressed without printing its contents.
cases.expectedBehavior: Measure both artifacts with the same redacted metric surface, apply hard limits and declared growth deltas, identify owners, and avoid deleting behavior merely because it is large.

cases.prompt: Validate the first-render and swipe p95 timings I captured from a named SillyTavern browser/device setup, separately from the card size report.
cases.expectedBehavior: Require a named environment and sufficient captured samples, calculate deterministic percentiles per scenario, and keep static and real-runtime gates independent.

cases.prompt: Audit this card's local and remote media plus Live2D model, motions, expressions, provider, fallback, and teardown bindings without downloading anything.
cases.expectedBehavior: Verify local containment, bytes and hashes, leave remote sources uncontacted, require an explicit Live2D provider and fallback, and pair load/play actions with teardown.

cases.prompt: Plan eager, lazy, and on-demand media under a byte budget and check that BGM playback stops on chat teardown without replacing the user's whole playlist.
cases.expectedBehavior: Produce a non-network preload plan, enforce declared byte and count limits, use only BGM or ambient audio contracts, preserve existing settings, and validate deterministic cleanup.
